title: Employee Handbook & Workplace Governance Manual (2026 Edition)
summary: Standard workplace policies for Northbridge Holdings Group including working hours, PTO, travel expense limits, acceptable use, and document classification rules.
content:
NORTHBRIDGE HOLDINGS GROUP — EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK (2026 EDITION)

1. Work Schedule & Paid Time Off
Full-time exempt staff work a standard 40-hour schedule with hybrid flexibility (minimum three in-office days per week). Full-time employees accrue 22 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) annually plus 11 company-observed holidays.

2. Business Travel & Expense Reimbursement
- Daily Meal Cap: Up to $150 per travel day with itemized receipts.
- Lodging Cap: Up to $320 per night in Tier-1 metro areas ($220 standard).
- Airfare: Economy cabin required for flights under 6 hours.

3. Information Classification & Record Handling
Every company record carries one of four labels: PUBLIC, INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL, or RESTRICTED. Employees may access only records required for their assigned role. Company records are read-only in document assistant sessions; staff must never attempt bulk exports or share restricted compensation details.

4. Security Incident Reporting
Suspected phishing, prompt-injection payloads in vendor attachments, or unauthorized access attempts must be reported immediately to security-ops@northbridge.example.
